name: Green Hills of Stranglethorn - Chapter II

meta.wiki: Green Hills of Stranglethorn - Chapter II

summary: Chapter II is one of four parts of Master Nesingwary’s scattered manuscript, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn. Its pages must be gathered so Barnil can assemble the chapters and return the book to Nesingwary.

sections.title: Scattered Pages
sections.body: Barnil had gathered most of the manuscript when a gust swept through Master Nesingwary’s camp. The pages of Chapter II were scattered through Stranglethorn with the rest. You can help Barnil put the four chapters in order, then carry them back to him.

faq.answer: Chapter II is one part of Master Nesingwary’s manuscript, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn.
Barnil is collecting and organizing the scattered chapters for Master Nesingwary.
A large gust of wind swept through Master Nesingwary’s camp and scattered the manuscript pages through the jungle.

faq.q: What should I do with the chapters?
faq.answer: Gather all four chapters and return them to Barnil so he can organize them for Master Nesingwary.

faq.q: Who wrote The Green Hills of Stranglethorn?
faq.answer: Master Nesingwary is the author of The Green Hills of Stranglethorn.
